Start with something worth making. Solve a real problem, keep the purpose clear, and give every feature a reason to be there.
components.css: .ds-principle{border-top:1px solid var(--line,#879478);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#879478);padding:28px 0;color:var(--ink,#1c3825)}.ds-principle summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:30px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;font-family:var(--display,"Fraunces Variable",Georgia,serif);font-size:27px;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.3}.ds-principle summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-principle summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--moss,#526645);outline-offset:8px}.ds-principle summary span{position:relative;width:32px;height:32px;flex:none}.ds-principle summary span:before,.ds-principle summary span:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:24px;height:1px;left:4px;top:15px;background:var(--ink,#1c3825);transition:transform .3s}.ds-principle summary span:after{transform:rotate(90deg)}.ds-principle[open] summary span:after{transform:rotate(0)}.ds-principle p{font-family:var(--body,"Linden Hill",Georgia,serif);font-size:22px;line-height:1.6;max-width:620px;margin:24px 0 5px;color:#405137}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
A cream sculptural rabbit, mossy miniature landscape and generous organic serif lettering make the studio feel caring, unhurried and quietly playful. Large uninterrupted color fields carry the editorial passages; fine rules and round controls keep the interface light.

This is the independent Relaxed Rabbit website identity. It does not inherit the Lulu theme of My Arabic Vocab. The approved first-surface composition is recorded in `.impeccable/surfaces/index-html.md` and `.impeccable/mocks/meadow-original.png`; the implemented source is `index.html`, `src/style.css` and `src/main.ts`. Later CSS declarations win. Desktop and mobile review captures are `.impeccable/review/desktop.png` and `.impeccable/review/mobile.png`; the additional in-app capture is `.impeccable/review/user-675.png`.
keyCharacteristics: Sunlit oat ground, forest ink and restrained sage and yellow accents.
Soft, weighty display serif paired with human, readable serif copy.
Panoramic illustration, broad editorial sections and native disclosures.
Scroll-linked movement with a fully readable still state.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.body: Carry section identity through uninterrupted color fields and typography, as in the cream, forest and sage passages.

dos: **Do** preserve the warm meadow, organic serif and broad color-field identity.
**Do** follow the final CSS cascade and review both 800px and 480px responsive transitions.
**Do** preserve semantic navigation, disclosures, visible focus and the reduced-motion still state.
**Do** use truthful English studio copy and retain artwork provenance when replacing assets.
donts: **Don't** import the Lulu app theme into this independent website.
**Don't** imply the generated meadow has independently animated rabbit body parts.
**Don't** invent projects, clients, metrics, testimonials or a public contact email.
**Don't** turn existing ornamental captions into a reusable eyebrow system.
